rationale: Threat-model review of the approved design before implementation lands.

findings.message: DNS rebinding can bypass creation-time host checks; acceptable for v1 if documented and re-validated at redirect time later
findings.resolution: Documented as a known limitation in docs/design.md (Risks); re-validating hosts at redirect time is planned for a later version.

findings.message: shortUrl derives from the Host header unless shortener.base-url is configured; set it in production
findings.resolution: The design makes shortener.base-url the production setting; the implementation must honour it (checked in the final review).
